AREV.justification: The descent of the divine into the human condition.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the believer into the life of the Logos.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential identity of the subject as the object of the path.

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of the divine into the human and the eternal.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative alignment with the divine reality.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation of the fallen state.

ENGAGR.justification: The holding of both human and divine natures without resolution into one.
